compiled_state.title: As a bridge operator, I want every outbound Jira create to write both the dso-id label and dso_local_id property with mandatory-or-alert discipline, so that identity is always present and searchable.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Mandatory-or-alert label+property write on every outbound create. If either fails, applier closes the partially-created issue and files a bridge-alert.

## Done Definitions
- Every outbound create writes dso-id:<uuid> as a label AND dso_local_id as an entity property in the same logical operation ← Satisfies: sc-3
- If either write fails post-create, applier attempts to close the issue and emits bridge-alert tagged 'create-identity-write-failed' ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Test harness simulating property-write failure produces exactly one bridge-alert and zero label-only Jira issues ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Test harness exercising a successful outbound create reads back both the dso-id label and the dso_local_id property from the created Jira issue and asserts both are present with correct values ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations
- [Architecture] Property writes use separate REST endpoint from create; sequence is inherently two-phase.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
